U.S. District Judge Zahid Quraishi in Trenton, New Jersey, ordered the drugmaker's Janssen unit to pay $360 million for violating the federal False Claims Act.  He also imposed $1.28 billion in civil fines, or $8,000 for each of 159,574 false claims the jury found were submitted to programs such as Medicare, Medicaid and the AIDS Drug Assistance Program.
